nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_8
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Gets the current angle of the wall run\'s arc. Finds the Dot product of the player\'s velocity and the same velocity with Z set to 0. Negative values get flipped to positive when doing this, so the final value is multiplied by the sign (1 or -1) of the original Z value.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Find how fast we\'re turning around an outside corner and map it to a range of 0-1. To do this, we get the delta of the character\'s current and previous rotation, map it to a range of -1 to 1, switch the sign depending on what side the wall is on (so that outside corners always result in a positive value), then clamp the value so it can\'t be below 0 because we aren\'t interested in the turn rate of inside corners. The turn rate float is then interpolated so that its value changes are smooth.
